per_key_semantic_review.reason: 亲切 naturally describes friendly, approachable delivery, not literal heat; directly agrees with 友好而亲切。
中性 is idiomatic for emotionally unmarked tone under 语气; the nearby description disambiguates it from the separate gender setting.
明快 naturally describes upbeat, energetic speaking rhythm/tone; not literal visual brightness. It can coexist with any expressiveness level: tone quality and degree of animation are distinct controls.
沉稳 naturally describes steady, composed delivery and agrees with 从容而沉稳。; it does not turn this tone choice into a speed or volume slider.
笃定 means confident/assured, matching the source explanation and sidecar rather than the misleading 权威/专横 readings.
低 is the natural scalar label under 表现力, not an instruction to lower volume or pitch; description correctly anchors restrained delivery.
中 is the natural middle member of 低/中/高. The unchanged 当前固定使用的值。 describes the existing standard value, not a mathematical constant or a claim that the voice never varies.
高 is the natural scalar label under 表现力; 活泼而有表现力。 anchors expressive variation, not higher pitch or volume.
